C0159: Proved for unimodular transitive graphs (Timar, 2006). For nonunimodular quasi-transitive graphs, Bell, Chu, Rodgers, Terlov and Tserunyan (arXiv:2509.10631, 2025) proved that for any two heavy clusters the vertices of one within distance one of the other form a set of finite total weight; light clusters, and finiteness in place of finite weight, remain open.
